metadata.case_name: YU YIXIN v. LEUNG CHI TIN ANDY

plaintiff.education_level: Received education in Guangzhou up to Primary 6 level; later stated Primary 4 but deemed to have reached Form 2 level

injuries.description: fractures of right distal radius and ulnar styloid process with residual pain and stiffness
source: Dr Kong diagnosed the Plaintiff to suffer from “fractures of right distal radius and ulnar styloid process with residual pain and stiffness”.
X-rays of right wrist showed fracture of right distal radius and ulnar styloid.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture at other specified part of wrist or hand level

source: there was a 5cm abrasion over left forearm.
injuries.icd_description: Abrasion of other or unspecified parts of forearm

manifestations.description: swelling, deformity and decreased movements over right wrist
mild limitation of motions of his right wrist in flexion and extension movements
mild irregularity and narrowing of right distal radioulnar joint with propensity to early ostheoarthritis of the wrist joint

treatments_received: closed reduction and complete short arm Plaster of Paris cast
physiotherapy (14 sessions including ice therapy, whirlpool therapy, right wrist mobilisation and strengthening exercises) from 9th September 2005 to 18th January 2006
occupational therapy: work rehabilitation training, functional capacity evaluation, job analysis and work-stimulated evaluation
admission to orthopaedics ward and Specialist Out-Patient Clinic follow-up
treatments_future: physiotherapy as needed (Dr Kong estimated HK$300 per session, 3 times weekly for 3 months totalling HK$10,800)

losses.description: residual pain/stiffness, mild limitation of motions of his right wrist in flexion and extension movements, and weakness of right hand grip
